attchmntText: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet on November 18, 2026
voiceSummary: Premier Energies Limited has intimated that its management will attend institutional investor and analyst meets. The company will participate in the JM Financial Annual Conference 2026 on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. Additionally, the management will attend the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum 2026 on November 18, 2026, also in Mumbai. These meetings include group and one-on-one sessions. The schedule is subject to change. Discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Premier Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Premier Energies Limited filed a notice regarding the transcript of its earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total revenue of INR2,656 crores, an increase of 38.2% year-on-year. EBITDA grew by 17.8% to INR760 crores, while profit after tax increased by 30.8% to INR462 crores. The company commissioned its 7 GW TOPCon cell line, with commercial production expected later in November 2026. New order wins totaled INR4,001 crores, bringing the total order book to INR16,260 crores. The transformer business order book reached INR330 crores. Management expects battery energy storage systems to become operational in Q2 2027. Phase 1 of the ingot-wafer plant is targeted for commissioning by December 2027.

Premier Energies Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report details the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. Shareholder approval was obtained via special resolution dated April 06, 2025, to change the project location for the 4 GW solar PV cell facility from Ranga Reddy District, Telangana to Tirupati District, Andhra Pradesh. The company has obtained various statutory approvals including building permits and factory approvals, while the License to Store and Handle Hazardous Substances from PESO is pending. As of September 30, 2026, the total unutilized amount stands at Rs 17.14 million. This amount is invested in fixed deposits with Axis Bank and held in public offer and monitoring accounts.

attchmntText: Communication To Shareholders - Intimation Of Tax Deduction At Source (TDS)
voiceSummary: Premier Energies Limited approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The board meeting was held on November 4th, 2026. The record date for eligibility is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Dividends will be paid electronically to shareholders with updated bank mandates in their demat accounts. The company will deduct tax at source under the Income-tax Act, 2025, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026. Tax rates vary based on shareholder category and residential status. Resident individuals receiving up to Rs. 10,000 in total dividends for the financial year 2026-27 are exempt from tax deduction. Shareholders must update their Permanent Account Number and residential status with the registrar or depository participants. Documents for lower or no tax deduction must be submitted to the registrar by November 11, 2026. Failure to provide valid documentation may result in higher tax deduction rates.
